text: 9月18日，国新办举行介绍第140届中国进出口商品交易会（广交会）有关情况的新闻发布会。商务部对外贸易司司长杨涛谈了我国外贸表现以及未来预期。杨涛表示，今年前8个月，我国外贸延续了良好的发展态势，进出口规模达到34.8万亿元，增长17.6%，其中，出口增长14.6%，进口增长22%，进口增速明显快于出口。外贸动能向新、结构向优的特征更加明显。
text_en: On September 18, the State Council Information Office held a press conference introducing matters related to the 140th China Import and Export Fair (Canton Fair). Yang Tao, Director of the Department of Foreign Trade of the Ministry of Commerce, discussed China's foreign trade performance and future expectations. Yang Tao said that in the first eight months of this year, China's foreign trade continued its good development momentum, with the scale of imports and exports reaching 34.8 trillion yuan, an increase of 17.6%, among which exports grew by 14.6% and imports grew by 22%, with import growth clearly faster than export growth. The characteristics of foreign trade momentum turning toward new areas and the structure turning toward improvement are more evident.
